decisions.rationale: The passage gives selected comparisons but does not report e5 outperforming every Model M variant across all four metrics or the Recall@200 near-tie.
It reports the absence of significance testing, but not that sparse or incomplete judgments make recall-based transfer results unreliable.
It reports some baseline-specific variation, but omits Model M-40M’s weakness, size dependence, Recall@200 comparisons, and gte-modernbert-base’s failure.
It reports e5 superiority for MRR@100 and NDCG@100 only, omitting both recall comparisons and the 0.001 Recall@200 margin.
It covers three metrics but omits Recall@200, including the important result that Model M-110M trailed e5 by only 0.001.
It characterizes transfer as non-generalizing against the best baseline, obscuring the mixed baseline-specific results and omitting size dependence and gte-modernbert-base’s failure.
